title: FRQ (b): longest warm streak
prompt:
Part (b): implement `longestWarmStreak(double[] readings)` returning the length of the **longest consecutive run** of readings strictly above 15.0.

Example: `{20.1, 16.0, 3.0, 18.0, 19.5, 20.0}` → `3` (the final three).

tests.name: warm streak length
tests.hint: Run counter + best tracker; reset the counter when a reading fails the threshold.
